_comment: Lobster Monitor observation record: the eight Maine sellers whose public pages are captured on a schedule. Copied on 2026-09-24 from the private wedding lobster monitor's sources.json (retail sources only); the official sources it also listed are fetched by ../../tools/fetch.py instead. Sources are added or marked retired; never removed. Sellers appear in editions by letter; the letter map is lobster/sources.json retail_reference_sources.

sources.name: Taylor Lobster (Kittery, ME)
sources.label: PUBLIC RETAIL / DIRECT-SHIP PROXY
sources.why: Requested by owner. Publishes a dated, shell-typed, per-pound retail price list on its homepage (chix / quarters / halves / selects, plus fresh picked meat). The only source found that states shell type and a price date on the page itself.
sources.purchase_mode: in-store pickup only (site states it no longer ships)
sources.shipping_note: Not applicable: pickup only per homepage text, 2026-09-11.

sources.name: Harbor Fish Market (Portland, ME)
sources.label: PUBLIC RETAIL / DIRECT-SHIP PROXY
sources.why: Requested by owner. Portland retail market. WooCommerce Store API exposes per-size prices for live hard shell and live soft shell separately, plus fresh picked meat by variety.
sources.purchase_mode: ship or local pickup; soft shell listed as local customers only
sources.shipping_note: Shipping calculated at checkout, not in listed price (store checkout, 2026-09-11).

82802.note: Frozen Maine lobster tails, up to 4 oz each, 2 to a pack (product title); price is per pack of 2.

sources.name: LobsterAnywhere (Maine direct-ship)
sources.label: PUBLIC RETAIL / DIRECT-SHIP PROXY
sources.why: Requested by owner. WooCommerce Store API exposes per-lobster prices by weight (1.25, 1.5, 2, 3, 5-6 lb). Shell type not stated in product data.
sources.origin_claim: Maine (site branding); product data does not state origin per item
sources.render_note: PDF render dropped 2026-09-11 to bound repository size; HTML, full-page PNG, and the JSON product feed are retained.

sources.name: Pine Tree Seafood & Produce (Scarborough, ME)
sources.label: PUBLIC RETAIL / DIRECT-SHIP PROXY
sources.why: Added during source investigation. Scarborough retail market whose WooCommerce Store API lists live Maine lobster by size with hard shell and soft shell as separate products and an in-stock flag. Second Maine source with an explicit shell split, which is what the hard/soft comparison needs.
sources.shipping_note: Not stated in product data; not verified.

sources.name: Get Maine Lobster (Portland, ME)
sources.label: PUBLIC RETAIL / DIRECT-SHIP PROXY
sources.why: Added during source investigation. Shopify products.json exposes live Maine lobster by weight band and pack count. Shell type not stated. Adds an independent direct-ship price point.
sources.shipping_note: Product page stated free shipping over an order threshold on 2026-09-11; unit prices below do not itemize shipping. Recorded as unknown.
sources.render_note: PDF render dropped 2026-09-11 to bound repository size; HTML, full-page PNG, and the JSON product feed are retained.

sources.name: Maine Lobster Now (Saco, ME)
sources.label: PUBLIC RETAIL / DIRECT-SHIP PROXY
sources.why: Added during source investigation. Shopify products.json exposes live Maine lobster at 1, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2 lb with pack-count variants. Shell type not stated.
sources.shipping_note: Site advertised conditional free shipping on 2026-09-11; unit prices do not itemize shipping. Recorded as unknown.
sources.origin_claim: Maine (product titles); Canadian items excluded by title regex
sources.render_note: PDF render dropped 2026-09-11 to bound repository size; HTML, full-page PNG, and the JSON product feed are retained.

sources.name: Cousins Maine Lobster (online shop)
sources.label: PUBLIC RETAIL / DIRECT-SHIP PROXY
sources.why: Added during source investigation. Shopify products.json exposes live lobster at 1.25, 1.5, 2 lb. Product title states a minimum of 2; the variant price is treated as per lobster only because the 4-pack bundle price is consistent with that reading. Flagged in notes on every observation.
sources.shipping_note: Not stated in product data; not verified.
sources.origin_claim: Maine (brand); product title does not state origin

parser_args.quantity_note: Variant price read as per lobster; product title states minimum order of 2. Unverified against checkout.

sources.render_note: PDF render dropped 2026-09-11 to bound repository size; HTML, full-page PNG, and the JSON product feed are retained.

sources.name: Greenhead Lobster (Stonington, ME)
sources.label: PUBLIC RETAIL / DIRECT-SHIP PROXY
sources.why: Added during source investigation. Stonington dealer that also sells direct. WooCommerce variations expose price by (number of lobsters x size), so a per-lobster price is computable at several pack sizes. Shell type not stated.
sources.shipping_note: Not stated in product data; not verified.
sources.render_note: PDF render dropped 2026-09-11 to bound repository size; HTML, full-page PNG, and the JSON product feed are retained.
